snippet.title: Gilly and The Isle of Sorrows reveal trailer New adventure game for the Panic Play date handheld
snippet.description:
Solve the mystery and uncover the secrets that plague the island and its inhabitants. Just why are so many sailors missing and why are all the ships destroyed? Journey across the island, voyage through treacherous caverns, seek the secrets of the cemetery and soak up the soothing pixel waves in this pocket sized nautical narrative adventure only on playdate!

 Gilly and the Isle of Sorrow is designed for a single sit-down playthrough but will feature loads of easter eggs and narrative details to keep you coming back to soak up all the island has to offer. 

follow our progress on Itch :DarkNStormyGames@itch.io/gilly-and-the-isle-of-sorrow

Until then,
Dark N' Stormy Games
